response.sql: WITH cc AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM cc), above AS (SELECT cc.cnt FROM cc, stats WHERE cc.cnt > stats.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(above.cnt) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(above.cnt * 1.0 / stats.total_cnt) AS avg_share_of_total, AVG(above.cnt - stats.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM above, stats

assumptions.assumption: Rows with a NULL college_id form one group (GROUP BY puts them together), and that group counts as a college in both the all-college average and the total. COUNT(*) counts every player-year row, including those with NULL college_id.
The division uses 1.0 * count so the share is computed as a fraction rather than integer division, and no rounding is applied.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude the NULL-college_id group entirely, so only real colleges count toward the average, the total, and the set of colleges compared against the average.
alternatives.sql: WITH cc AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_college WHERE college_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY college_id), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM cc), above AS (SELECT cc.cnt FROM cc, stats WHERE cc.cnt > stats.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(above.cnt) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(above.cnt * 1.0 / stats.total_cnt) AS avg_share_of_total, AVG(above.cnt - stats.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM above, stats
